parse_obj_server_response: parse a server response dict, list, bytes, or JSON string into a typed dataclass instance with future-compatible extra fields
parse_obj_as_list_response: parse a server response and return a list of typed dataclass instances, raising an error if the result is not a list
parse_obj_as_instance_response: parse a server response and return a single typed dataclass instance, raising an error if the result is a list
normalize_key_header: normalize a header key by replacing hyphens and spaces with underscores and converting to lowercase
dataclass_with_extra_decorator: decorate a dataclass to include a custom __repr__ that displays all fields including extra dict attributes
